practice_claims.tradition: Ginkgo Evaluation of Memory randomized controlled trial
practice_claims.condition_or_goal: Prevent all-cause dementia or Alzheimer dementia in older adults
practice_claims.preparation: EGb 761 standardized leaf extract, 120 mg twice daily in study only
practice_claims.limitations: 3069 participants aged 75+; all-cause dementia HR 1.12 (95% CI 0.94–1.33), no reduction. This study regimen is not a general safety or dosing recommendation.

practice_claims.tradition: Chinese materia medica summarized by secondary practitioner reference

actions: 养阴 (nourish yin; secondary practitioner description)
framework_details.interpretation: These are TCM pattern concepts, not demonstrated physiological outcomes.

practice_claims.condition_or_goal: Traditional Lung/Stomach yin deficiency and dryness-pattern complaints
practice_claims.preparation: dried/reconstituted fungal fruiting body; not isolated polysaccharide
practice_claims.limitations: Secondary source; no primary pharmacopoeia page independently verified, no assumed meridian/nature/flavor/dose, no human efficacy established.

cultural_uses.tradition: Chinese food-medicine / materia medica secondary summary
cultural_uses.reported_use: Traditional nourishing-yin and moistening-dryness descriptions in Chinese practitioner summaries.
cultural_uses.limitations: Not human efficacy, not a therapeutic recommendation.

domain_notes.text: No human metabolic therapeutic benefit established by the GEM dementia prevention trial.
NCCIH warns of bleeding and drug-interaction concerns with leaf extracts and serious toxicity of ginkgo seeds.
A 3069-participant randomized trial found no prevention of dementia with standardized leaf extract.
No reliable mood/anxiety efficacy established by the cited dementia-prevention trial.
No human metabolic efficacy established by cited fungal-polysaccharide cell studies.

Purified TFP-F1 increased TNF-alpha and IL-6 secretion in J774A.1 cells at 1 microgram/mL; separate polysaccharide fractions suppressed LPS-triggered cytokines in RAW264.7 cells. Distinct preparations and models.
No human cognitive benefit demonstrated by cited studies.
No human affective or mood effect demonstrated by cited studies.

safety.alert: Ginkgo seeds can cause serious poisoning, including seizures. Leaf extract can interact with warfarin/other drugs and may increase bleeding risk; pregnancy safety is uncertain. Seed, leaf, and standardized extract are distinct exposures.

No therapeutic safe dose established from in-vitro polysaccharide experiments. Cultivated edible fruiting bodies, concentrated extracts and isolated TFP-F1 are not interchangeable. Correct fungal identity, contamination control and food allergy assessment remain important.

bioactivities.life_stage: older adults aged 75 years and above
bioactivities.study_model: randomized double-blind placebo-controlled clinical trial; N=3069; median follow-up 6.1 years
bioactivities.observed_effect: No statistically significant reduction in dementia incidence versus placebo (P=0.21). Trial hazard ratio 1.12 (95% CI 0.94–1.33), P=0.21.
bioactivities.dose_translation: 120 mg EGb 761 twice daily was study exposure, not recommended dosing.
bioactivities.limitations: Does not establish efficacy or safety of different extracts or in other populations.

bioactivities.target_taxon: Mus musculus-derived J774A.1 macrophage cell line
bioactivities.study_model: in vitro macrophage cytokine secretion assay with purified acetylated TFP-F1; exposure reported at 1 µg/mL
bioactivities.observed_effect: TFP-F1 increased TNF-alpha and IL-6 secretion in cultured macrophages; deacetylation reduced activity.
bioactivities.mechanism: Authors implicated TLR4 signaling; no direct receptor binding constant established here.
bioactivities.dose_translation: Cell-culture concentration cannot be translated into a human dose.
bioactivities.limitations: Specific acetylated fraction; not evidence that whole snow fungus stimulates human immunity.
